info: Open-Meteo MODEL DATA (not a local Tempest or other weather station feed). Edit DEFAULTS in CONFIG or set WX_LAT, WX_LON, WX_TIMEZONE and WX_LABEL. Example defaults target New York City; dashboard unit labels assume Fahrenheit/mph/inches. Dashboard 1.0 (node-red-dashboard 3.6.6), NOT Dashboard 2.0. The overview is a single-screen command center; 17 detailed charts are on supporting tabs.
